packages.name: Modern Dashboard
packages.description: Control-first Hubitat dashboard: select your devices and you're done. Optimized for acting on devices — bulk room/house lights, multi-thermostat control. Installable PWA, built-in remote scheduler (no Hubitat login), runs entirely on your hub.

packages.name: Auto Room Sorter
packages.description: Detect room names in device labels, create missing rooms, and sort unassigned devices into them.
